items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, knew him. I knew the cat, too. He used to drive on the show, on this minstrel show.

ctx.x: The guy that Lester was with.

Yeah, knew him. I knew the cat, too. He used to drive on the show, on this minstrel show. So he told Les, said, "Les, you ain't got no record, ain't got nothin'. I want you to go up and stand for this for me." Les, he went up there and stood up for that man. They said they had a hell of a hard time to try to keep them from sending him on a chain gang.
